title: Unattended work-item completion
brief: We receive work-item notifications on a lab workstation while nobody is present. The required outcome is: after a new item arrives, read the requested setting, interact with the desktop panel to apply it, and verify from the panel's saved state that it took effect. The item should finish without a person approving or operating each one. We can keep the workstation unlocked in the dedicated lab account. Recommend a complete configuration and the smallest useful test we should run next. Use the supplied, fictional product notes as authoritative for this exercise. We have not run a desktop test yet. State what can be concluded now and any condition on your recommendation; do not claim an unperformed test.
